descriptions.preferred: 'Seigen' is among the most popular cultivars of the group which develops bright crimson foliage in the spring. The new leaves range into the bright fire-red tones which last for several weeks and are reminiscent of the popular 'Corallinum'. They then develop a light green color for summer turning yellow to persimmon in fall. This cultivar is one of the first in the

rhs.description: A small, rounded, deciduous Japanese maple, multibranched, eventually reaching about 1.5m in height, with small 5-lobed leaves to 5cm long on short branches. The leaves emerge bright red when young, turning light green in summer then with orange and gold tints in autumn; suited to bonsai training

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dwarf group are compact and slow-growing, making them ideal for pots and containers

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。

care.cultivation: 宜栽于保水且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。半阴环境下叶色表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦边。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型、圆头的落叶日本枫，多分枝，最终高度约 1.5 米；短枝上着生小型五裂叶，叶长可达 5 厘米。幼叶展开时鲜红，夏季转为浅绿色，秋季带橙色和金色调；适合盆景培养。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Seigen' 是这一类春季抽生鲜亮深红叶品种中最受欢迎的品种之一。新叶可呈鲜明的火红色调，并持续数周，使人联想到广受欢迎的 'Corallinum'；随后夏季转为浅绿色，秋季变为黄色至柿子色。本品种在 'Corallinum' 类群中萌叶较早，因此容易受冷风和春霜危害。叶片较小、5 裂，秀致轻盈，长宽约 3-5 厘米，密生于短枝上。裂片深达叶基一半以上，叶缘轻微具齿，裂片尖端不特别锐利。叶柄硬挺，长 2-3 厘米。该矮生品种与 'Tama hime' 和 'Kiyohime' 相似，可形成高约 2 米的小型圆头灌丛。'Seigen' 在日本很受盆景爱好者欢迎。 另有一类直立生长的绿色羽裂型品种，在 Dissectum Group 中较为少见；绝大多数其他 dissectum 品种多为下垂或垂枝形。此绿色细裂叶枫与其他更典型的垂枝 dissectum 品种混植时，可形成悦目的对比。叶色为清新的亮绿色，春季展开时每片叶轻带红色尖端，随后很快转为均匀浅绿色；夏季后期，受光较强的叶缘又会重新出现红晕。秋色颇为壮观，从鲜金色到浅黄色，并在大多数叶片上带有绯红晕染。叶片略小于大多数其他绿色 dissectum 品种，长约 4-5 厘米，宽略大于长度。7 个裂片呈羽状深裂形成次裂片，其精细程度不如典型 dissectum 那样纤细，但又比
